title: Avanti — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Avanti.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Compact Solutions." Value tier. Avanti makes compact appliances — wine coolers, mini-fridges, portable dishwashers, and countertop appliances at value pricing. Strong in the dorm, office, and secondary appliance market.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Compact needs, dorms, offices, RVs. Budget secondary appliances.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Avanti:

• Widest compact appliance selection at value pricing

• Wine coolers and beverage centers at entry prices

• Portable dishwashers for apartments without hookups

• Dorm and office specialists

• Available at most major retailers
